newsitem.title: UK: One Brent kept, one clocked, Dated trades twice.
newsitem.headline: One Brent kept, one clocked, Dated trades twice.

text.p: One Brent cargo nominated loading dates of Feb 20-22 was kept ahead of the five o'clock deadline while the other went unclaimed, traders said.
Shell was clocked with a cargo while BP kept the other, which they then sold at a firmer March Brent +34 cents.
Another Brent cargo, due to load Feb 12-14, moved earlier between Wall Street traders for Mar Brent +25 cents, dealers said.
Brent cargoes are traded on a paper, or forward market until the 1700 London time deadline on the nearest trading day 15 days before their assigned loading date.
A trading company is clocked when it is left with a paper cargo which has turned physical after that deadline and therefore cannot be passed on as part of pre-sold paper cargo deals.
